description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityOperator' and related comparison and join operator classes used for constructing and managing query conditions in the OFBiz framework. It includes static registration and lookup of operators like equals, not-equal, less than, greater than, in, between, and logical operators AND/OR.

classes.name: EntityOperator
classes.description: Abstract base class for query operators (comparison and logical) used in building entity conditions.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: Abstract class for comparison operators (e.g., equals, less than, in).

classes.name: EntityJoinOperator
classes.description: Class for logical join operators (AND, OR).

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an operator with a given name, handling case variations and replacing '-' and '_'.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a registered operator by name.

methods.name: lookupComparison
methods.description: Retrieves a registered comparison operator by name, throws if not a comparison operator.

methods.name: lookupJoin
methods.description: Retrieves a registered join operator by name, throws if not a join operator.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if an entity matches the operator condition with given lhs and rhs.

methods.name: appendRHSList
methods.description: Appends a list of RHS values to a SQL string, separated by commas.

methods.name: appendRHSBetweenList
methods.description: Appends a list of RHS values for BETWEEN conditions, separated by AND.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the condition is empty.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a map matches the condition.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Abstract method to validate SQL syntax for the condition.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Abstract method to add SQL representation of the condition.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable condition object from lhs and rhs.
